title: fusion.repair-request/v1
description: DRAFT, plan step 12: the invocation input of fusion.repair.v1, the asset Prior would select as RequestSchema the way external_explorer.go at 6080ba76 selects the explorer's; request 69 proposes it and the host services it rests on, and step 15 freezes it on Prior's answer. Composition is trusted host code: task is the bounded request the operator approved, task_sha256 the identity of that approval (W1 of 261010-1504-span-map-and-repair-correspondence.md), record the workbench record the repair resolves, and runs the attempt map Prior answer 67.5 requires, every run host-provisioned and persisted before dispatch, the module creating none. runs.attempts has exactly revise_bound + 1 entries of workflows/repair.v1.json (1 + 1 = 2); the module refuses a shorter or longer map before any role call, and refuses a run id that appears twice. The role inputs are not carried here: each role step composes its task from this input and the preceding steps' answers and has the host freeze it through host.role.compose.v1 before the first role call (67.2: project_context and output_contract are the host's). audit_ref is the host's recovery overlay, absent at preparation and set on a fresh outer operation after a recorded recovery; the steps run in order and each role run settles before the next starts, so at most one run stands at answered on a restart, and the module sends audit_ref only as RoleCall.audit_ref on that run's host.role.complete.v1, never into any role input. No $schema keyword: the host compiles every bundle schema as draft 2020-12 and this file must carry no URL.

task.description: The bounded repair request, the bounds of Prior's embedded internal/repair/plan.go Task at 167c605: at most 8 criteria, 8 context paths, 4 write paths, 4 mandatory checks. The repository itself is the host's and never named here.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria the reviewer judges against; the host hashes them as criteria_sha256 of the review request.

context_paths.description: Repository-relative, each once; the explorer's path_scope and the implementer's reading scope.

write_paths.description: The bound write scope: a subset of context_paths, which JSON Schema cannot state and the host and the module both check.

checks.description: The mandatory checks host.capture.v1 runs after every attempt and host.integrate.v1 runs again; names unique, which the host checks. required is always true and baseline_failure always false: a repair ships no check it expects to fail.

base_revision.description: The full commit id the workspace is detached at and the diff is taken against.

findings_limit.description: The explore step's findings limit, as the explorer role input bounds it.

task_sha256.description: Host-minted: the identity of the approved task, in the host's sha256:<hex> form; the reviewer echoes it as plan_hash.

record.description: The workbench record the close step transitions through the codec: an issue (to closed, disposition fixed) or a work package (to done, outcome completed). The path is the record's control path relative to the workbench, as the codec names it; the host resolves it and the module never holds a filesystem path.

runs.description: The attempt map (67.5): one host-provisioned run per role per attempt, allocated and persisted before dispatch. The explorer and the state-auditor run once; each attempt has its own implementer and reviewer runs, on independent principals the host grants.

attempts.description: Entry i is attempt i, 0 first. Exactly revise_bound + 1 entries of workflows/repair.v1.json.

audit_ref.description: A host-recorded recovery audit reference for the one run standing at answered. Its presence never changes a role input.

run_id.description: A host-provisioned run; the module creates none.

path.description: Repository-relative: no leading slash, no segment starting with a dot, no backslash, colon or line break (Prior's pathOK at 167c605).
